text:
maria: @here CI red on main — linux-x64 integration/parquet_stream failing on worker-2. First red after the gzstream bump PR merged yesterday. Build: https://ci.redwood.ai/12345 :eyes:
ci-bot: build 12345 failed on job linux-x64/integration/parquet_stream (exit code 139). Log excerpt: `segfault in parquet::Reader::read_row_group`
jason: can someone bisect to narrow the culprit? last green looks like ~1891170000 according to pipeline history.
maria: I can start a local bisect against main. Will run `git bisect` against nightly artifacts and run the failing job headless. Posting steps: ```git bisect start HEAD $(git rev-list --before="2026-03-15" -n1 main) git bisect run ./ci/scripts/run_integration.sh --suite parquet_stream```
jason: thanks — I can hand you a spare GPU node if needed. ping me when you hit the offending commit.
sam: quick note — the test failure looks like ordering/async memory use. We recently switched the test harness to parallel workers in test-runner@2.3.0; that could interact with gzstream change. marking that as a suspect.
maria: bisect update: checked ~8 commits, repro is deterministic on my local runner. Failure first appears at commit `abcdef1` (PR #3421 — deps: bump gzstream to 1.4.2). Stack excerpt:
```
#0 0x7f8a2d3f in parquet::Reader::read_row_group
#1 0x7f8a2f12 in parquet::RowGroupIterator::next
#2 0x556b7c in integration::parquet_test::read_parquet
SIGSEGV at 0x0 (read of null)
```
leo: if bisect pinpoints the gzstream bump that's a straight revert candidate. We should prepare a revert PR and run full CI.
jason: i'll open the revert PR and request a short CI run. tagging @maria to validate repro/green after revert.
maria: opened revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/PR/3499 — reverting gzstream to 1.4.1, CI triggered (build 12346).
deploy-bot: CI rerun requested for PR 3499; jobs queued: linux-x64/integration/parquet_stream.
sam: temporary mitigation option: mark test flaky with @flaky annotation so release isn't blocked, but i prefer revert first so we don't ship a latent segfault.
leo: agreed revert first. we'll add a follow-up to run the harness under TSan/ASAN to catch memory races.
maria: plan for this thread: 1) revert gzstream bump (PR 3499) 2) wait for CI 12346 results 3) if green, merge revert and cut follow-up to investigate gzstream change and test-runner parallelization 4) postmortem w/ root cause. sound good?
jason: sounds good to me :thumbsup:. thanks for taking point, maria.
maria: thanks everyone — i'll update when CI 12346 finishes or if I hit a blocker.
